unexpected.title: OXESpace hit an unexpected error
unexpected.message: Something went wrong in the background.
unexpected.detail: Your terminals and agents may still be running, but OXESpace can no longer guarantee them. Restart to continue safely. Diagnostics can be exported from Settings > Diagnostics.

rendererGone.title: OXESpace stopped responding
rendererGone.detail: Your terminals and agents are still running. Restart OXESpace to bring the interface back; diagnostics can be exported from Settings > Diagnostics.
